The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a byproduct of dutiful [[farming]] (composting). It can either be decomposed after study into reagents for use in [[alchemy]], used as a bait for [[fishing]], or - under duress - consumed for a relatively tiny amount of energy.

==Alchemy==
{{PAGENAME}}s can be decomposed into a [[Life solution|solution]] or [[Life extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and either of the distillation cubes, respectively. However, the [[yellow flower]] is identical in regards to alchemy, making that the ideal choice as it's generally far more abundant and renewable. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.

==Fishing==
{{PAGENAME}}s can also be utilized while [[fishing]], as one of eight(8) available baits to choose from.
*There are eight(8) susceptible fish; the [[Tilapia]], [[Perch]], [[Eel]], [[Bream]], [[Sardine]], [[Pike]], [[Carp]], and [[Salmon]].
*The {{PAGENAME}} is practically a 'starter' bait; easy to collect, and most often having commonality with "No Bait".
*The Sardine is generally considered the best commodity, given a {{PAGENAME}} bait.
**There are ''better'' fish, though most can be caught using more cost-effective means.
**Salmon is a good alternate, though restricted to the [[Sea]] location and {{Quality|silver}}Quality.
